notes.title: Closed Beta — Follow-Up
notes.content:
We extend our gratitude for your participation in the closed beta and for your valuable, constructive feedback. Your insights are very helpful.

Based on your suggestions, we plan to refine the feature and will share the updates in an upcoming closed beta in the near future. We're unable to set a precise date, as the timeline for implementing changes remains uncertain. Rest assured, this feature will not be included in the next major update.
Here's a summary of the issues we'll address based on your feedback:
[list]
[*] Arcane toilet completion time is excessive: We'll adjust so it won't exceed twice the time needed to reach aura level 66 in the current system.
[*] Mana generation from item sacrifice: To prevent the need for transmogging for a maximum output, epic and legendary items will yield equal mana.
[*] Introducing spillover: This ensures no mana is wasted if the generated amount doesn't precisely match the required level completion.
[*] Return of upgrade materials: Upon item sacrifice, you'll receive back the materials used for upgrades.
[/list]
Other issues that need to be carefully examined include the disproportionate weapon damage caused by aura levels and the resulting impact on power scaling, the daily limit on the number of items that can be sacrificed, the loss of upgrade resources and gems upon making a sacrifice, and the stage in the game at which the toilet becomes truly relevant.

Regarding the issue of sacrificing gold-valued items, we view this as a strategic gameplay element, offering players a choice between using the item in the arcane toilet or throwing it into the witches cauldron to spent gained gold on attributes.

Your feedback continues to shape our game, and we appreciate your ongoing involvement.

notes.title: Producer's Note #29
notes.content:
[h3]Does the Paladin Make the Warrior Obsolete?
[/h3]Since the introduction of the Paladin class, we have received feedback expressing concerns that the Warrior class has become obsolete. Many players feel that the Paladin is stronger, leaving the Warrior as one of the weakest classes in the game.

We are currently exploring ways to enhance the Warrior class to make it more competitive; however, we are encountering several challenges. One significant issue is that the existing classes in dungeons are not straightforward to adjust. Any changes made would impact every dungeon where these classes are encountered.

To effectively improve the Warrior class, we first need to separate the PvE and PvP systems within the game. This separation would allow us to better feature other classes in dungeons, ultimately enriching the gameplay experience for all players.

[h3]Comment on Fusion Compensation
[/h3]The compensation strategy is designed to promote competition and innovation on future fused game worlds. It is grounded on the analysis of competitive characters, with compensation levels at approximately two-thirds of the potential experience (XP) players could earn in a specific period.

For gold, the compensation is set at about one-third of the total gold attainable by players, aligning with what a free-to-play (f2p) gamer could accumulate. While multiple formulas could be used to calculate gold from various activities like city guard, gold pit, and expeditions, a single formula based on expeditions has been chosen for its simplicity and lower risk of errors, ensuring the compensated gold amount remains consistent.

[h3]No New Server in January
[/h3]While some may be anticipating a new server launch in January, we want to inform you that we have decided not to release a new server this month. The next server launch is expected to occur in February.

notes.title: Producer's Note #28
notes.content:
In 2025, we will continue with the fusion of game worlds as announced. The affected game worlds will be informed well in advance.

After the last fusions, we received valuable feedback from the community. It was noted that the age differences between the game worlds and the characters within them pose a disadvantage for the younger characters. They have a hard time remaining competitive in the fused game world.

To mitigate these disadvantages, we will take the following measures from now on when game worlds are fused:
[list]
[*] Level-Ups: For each game world that is part of a fusion, the time between its own server launch and the server launch of the oldest game world in the fusion will be calculated in months (rounded to 0.5 months). The resulting factor will be multiplied by 2 to determine the number of levels by which a character will be increased.
[*] Gold Bonus: The aforementioned time factor will also be taken into account here. Additionally, the character level immediately before the merger will play a role in calculating the gold bonus. Roughly speaking, one receives approximately the amount of gold per month that one would obtain from expeditions if one spends 320 adventure points on about 25 days in the month, with the Dragon Griffin/Griffin Dragon being active.
[/list]
With this measure, we aim to promote fairer competition in fused game worlds and make the gaming experience in these worlds more attractive.

notes.title: Producer’s Note #26.1 - Survey Results Pt. 1
notes.content:
Over the past few weeks, we have sought your feedback through several surveys. We want to share the results of the first batch of surveys with you and outline the actions we will take as a result.

The improvements mentioned below will be part of the upcoming update (version 22.700).
[h3]Hellevator - Leaving a Guild or Being Kicked From a Guild Will Be Restricted[/h3]
We inquired whether we should trial a Hellevator event with added restrictions. This idea received support from the majority of participants. As a result, we will prohibit guild members from leaving their guild while the Hellevator event is active. However, members will be permitted to leave once the event concludes and the reward claim phase begins. Guild members will be protected from being kicked out during the event, although characters that are deleted will be removed.
[h3]Character Screen Displayed in International Hall of Fame[/h3]
There was a consensus to include character screens in the international hall of fame. This feature will be implemented.
[h3]Guild War - Attacking and Defending Guild Members Visible to All[/h3]
To enhance visibility regarding the presence of attacking and defending guild members before a guild fight, feedback suggests that everyone should have the ability to view both defenders and attackers within the guild member list. We're taking action to incorporate this feature to ensure that everyone has access to this information.
[h3]Inserting Gems on Items Without Socket[/h3]
Currently, if you attempt to insert a gem into an item that lacks a socket, you must visit the blacksmith to add a socket to the item before you can insert the gem.

Community feedback suggests that it would be more convenient to add a socket to an item in the same step as inserting a gem. We have listened to this feedback and will implement a function that allows adding a gem and creating a socket in a single action.

notes.title: Closed Beta Test – The Paladin 2.0
notes.content:
We are excited to test the revised Paladin class, which has been updated based on feedback from the community.

The Paladin now possesses a healing ability, and we are eager to learn if this change meets your expectations and ensures the class is competitive with others. Therefore, your input on the survey, which will be available on the second day of the closed beta, is vital. Your feedback is essential for developing a class that gains wide acceptance.

To allow more participants the opportunity to join the closed beta, we have once again increased the number of available access slots to 2,500.

[h3]Adjustments[/h3]
[list]
[*] The following values have been adjusted for the Paladin class:
[*] Constitution multiplicator: 6 (was 7)
[*] Max. damage reduction: 83.3 % (was 72 %)
[*] Damage factor: 45 % (was 55 %)
[*] Defensive Stance: Shield of Faith
[list]
[*]50 % chance to block attack and heal 50 % of taken damage

notes.content:
Welcome to the fourth installment of our producer's notes, where we delve into the UI/UX rework of the character screen and backpack. This update aims to enhance user interaction and streamline the accessibility of game features.
[h3]Character Screen Modifications[/h3]
The upper part of the character screen remains largely unchanged to maintain familiarity. However, we've restructured the bottom section into three distinct parts, improving overall navigation and making it easier to interact with other players directly – actions like fighting and comparing stats are now more accessible.
[h3]Backpack Enhancements[/h3]
We've relocated the backpack to the bottom of the mobile character screen. This adjustment required a redesign of the layout for other screens to ensure a cohesive user experience. The new, large scrollable backpack format replaces the traditional chests, offering a more intuitive and space-efficient way to manage items.

The backpack now operates context-sensitively, enhancing item interaction based on the screen you're viewing:
[list]
[*] In your character view, items unsuitable for your class are marked as "no interaction possible”, helping you manage your inventory efficiently.
[*] When accessing the smith screen, each item displays the resources you'll gain upon dismantling, making decision-making simpler.
[*] On the toilet screen, items that can be discarded are clearly indicated, streamlining the cleanup process.
[/list]
These changes are designed to make the game interface both visually appealing and user-friendly, improving the overall gaming experience.

notes.title: Producer’s Note #21.3

Welcome to the third installment of our producer's notes, focusing on the UI/UX rework of our game's menu and city map. This update aims to enhance navigation and interactive elements for a seamless gaming experience.
[h3]Menu Enhancements[/h3]
We've introduced categories with dynamic feature icons to simplify navigation. Previously, over 20 features were listed in one view, which was cumbersome. Now, features are grouped by category with icons indicating their state – news, upgrade, progress, or locked. This visual differentiation improves orientation and gameplay efficiency.

Key features like the Legendary Dungeon and Hellevator are now easily accessible in the menu. For mobile users, the bottom menu bar dynamically adjusts based on the selected category, streamlining transitions and interactions within individual feature screens.
[h3]City Map Redesign[/h3]
The city map is redesigned to represent each game feature as a building, adding engagement and providing a comprehensive overview of functionalities. The map also shows the various icon states of each feature, allowing players to quickly assess their progress and updates directly from the map.

These updates create a more organized and visually appealing interface that enhances both aesthetics and usability. Stay tuned for our next note, where we'll explore changes for the character screen and backpack in detail.

notes.title: Producer’s Note #21.2
notes.content:
Welcome to the second installment of our seven-part series on our game’s UI/UX rework. This note addresses the general adjustments needed based on your feedback and our own observations.
[h3]Menu Adjustments[/h3]
[list]
[*] Dual-feature Buttons: Currently, some buttons host two features, requiring double presses, which is unintuitive. This setup results in unequal feature access and lacks clear notifications for each function.
[*] Expansion Constraints: Our existing design limits the ability to add new features.
[/list]
[h3]City Map Usability[/h3]
[list]
[*] Feature Representation: Essential elements like the underworld or arena manager are missing, and others are inadequately displayed, making it challenging to navigate the game map.
[/list]
[h3]Tutorial Content[/h3]
[list]
[*] Overwhelming Text: The tutorial's lengthy texts deter new players. We plan to slightly adjust and simplify the tutorial.
[/list]
[h3]Character Navigation[/h3]
[list]
[*] Complex Layout: The current character screen is not user-friendly. We aim to simplify navigation and manage information more intuitively.
[*] Equipment Management: We’re moving towards a drag-and-drop interface for equipment management, consolidating all items into a single backpack accessible across necessary screens.
[/list]
[h3]Backpack Functionality[/h3]
[list]
[*] Unified Storage: We will streamline storage by using one backpack for all items, reducing confusion and enhancing gameplay.
[/list]
These adjustments will make the game more intuitive and enjoyable. Our next notes will outline specific changes and implementation strategies.

notes.title: Producer's Note #17
notes.content:
Today we would like to inform you about important updates that aim to improve the gaming experience for everyone. We are aware that the support of our Content Creators with free game currency has led to discussions. We want to clarify: The provision of mushrooms is not a gift but rather recognition and appreciation for the hard work and creative effort that our Content Creators put in every day.

Some of you have expressed concerns that this affects competitiveness. We have taken your feedback seriously and introduced a new, automated system to distribute the game currency fairly and evenly. The goal is to create a harmonious gaming experience for everyone.

It's not just about the number of subscribers when it comes to support. We also consider the quality of the content and average viewer numbers, among other things. We want to promote Content Creators who are passionate and dedicated.

With our new system, mushrooms are now distributed according to levels and set caps, striving for a balance between supported characters and the rest of the player field. This ensures that everyone has the same chance of success and that no one unintentionally dominates the leaderboards.

[b]Mushroom Preset[/b] (highest tier)
[list]
[*] Level 2-300: 500 daily mushrooms, level 301-400: 250 daily mushrooms, level 401-500: 125 daily mushrooms, from level 501: 25 daily mushrooms (subject to change)
[*] Starter packs when requirements are fulfilled
[*] Bonus mushrooms: 3,000 for Legendary Dungeons, 1,000 for Hellevators
[/list]
The updates apply immediately to new characters on new servers and will be implemented gradually for existing characters.

We appreciate your passion and the commitment you put into S&F. These changes are a step towards making the game fairer and more exciting for everyone. If you have any questions or suggestions, you can always contact us as usual.

Thank you for your understanding and support!

notes.title: Producer’s Note #14 - Change of the Demon Hunter Class Icon
notes.content:
After changing the class icon of the Berserker, we are now also giving the class icon of the Demon Hunter a new coat of paint and would like to explain how the new class icon came about.

[h3]Why the change?[/h3]
Since, similar to the Berserker, the class icon of the Demon Hunter only depicts a weapon (the crossbow), which does not reflect the class ability, we wanted to choose an icon that is familiar to you on the one hand and reflects the ability of this class on the other hand. Since the crossbow as a weapon is not solely used by the Demon Hunter (the Scout also uses crossbows), we wanted to change this.

[h3]What was important to us?[/h3]
We are aware that the changes to the existing class icons represent a major intervention in your gameplay. As with previous changes, the class icon of the Demon Hunter has emerged through many internal discussions and we have tried to stay as close as possible to the original vision of the Demon Hunter and to optimize it mainly.

In order to address the Demon Hunter's individual ability more closely with the class icon, we focused on his Elixir of Revival. Since this elixir visually resembles the large endurance potion (“Potion of the Long Distance Runner”) too much, we wanted to make a clearer distinction here to represent the uniqueness of the elixir. In addition to the shape of the bottle, we added white bat wings. These wings symbolize both the ability of the Demon Hunter to be able to resurrect after death, and his class-specific connection to the demon world.

[h3]Class Selection[/h3]
The visual representation of the Demon Hunter in the class selection has been expanded by giving him an aura of demonic wings to give him a special form and to emphasize his ability to resurrect. The bottles attached to the belt have also been adjusted in shape.

The red glow that previously surrounded the crossbow is not found in the color scheme in the artwork for the Demon Hunter. We have chosen a whitish glow, which surrounds the winged elixir in the class icon. This glow also surrounds the Demon Hunter in the class selection and ensures that the new class icon allows a clearer distinction from other class icons in the Hall of Fame, for example.

notes.title: Alternative Feature for Daily Tasks
notes.content:
We've been thinking about how we can make the checklist and the secret mission of the day more interesting and less monotonous. With more variance and a goal to work towards, we believe that motivation can be increased to devote oneself to daily tasks and to no longer view them as a necessary evil.
[h3]The Concept of Daily Tasks[/h3]
We have set the following requirements for ourselves in the development of the event:
[list]
[*] The checklist and the secret mission of the day should be completely replaced by the new feature.
[*] The tasks of the checklist should remain.
[*] Every game feature should be depicted and packaged into tasks.
[*] There should be fixed, daily tasks, as well as randomly generated ones with various goals, which should be comparable to the secret mission of the day.
[*] The rewards of the daily tasks should be based on the "secret mission of the day" and also scale with the heads of the Hydra.
[*] In addition to the daily tasks, there should be varied tasks that the player can fulfill over an event period from Monday to Thursday each week. This should give the player the opportunity to work towards something and make the gaming experience more varied. These tasks should mostly have an overarching theme.
[*] The rewards of the event tasks should depend on the respective event. However, the player should be able to earn another beer if enough tasks have been completed.
[/list]
Here you get a small glimpse of the tasks that can be completed: [url=https://bit.ly/DailyTasksBeta]https://bit.ly/DailyTasksBeta[/url].

notes.title: Producer's Note #13
notes.content:
It has been a while since server merges were discussed and enthusiastically announced. Due to the challenges we had to face during and after the backend migration, the topic of server consolidation fell somewhat into the background.

We are all the more pleased to announce that we have not been idle over the past few months and have been working on a concept together with community representatives. Now, as the first test merges look promising, we would like to provide you with more detailed information.

The goal of the server merges is clear. After 14 years, naturally older servers are not as active and by merging these servers we hope to ensure more rivalry and activity in the daily gameplay for the players who are still active there.
[h2]Concept[/h2]
Next, we briefly introduce our concept. Both technical aspects and aspects to ensure fair competition have been taken into account:
[h3]General[/h3]
[list]
[*] Any number of servers can be merged.
[*] All characters will be transferred to a new server, the following rules apply:
[*] For each origin server, one character can be played on the merged server.
[*] Characters below level 10, which have not been active for a year and for which no money has been spent, will be deleted.
[/list]
[h3]Character Names[/h3]
In the case of multiple characters with the same name, these characters will be renamed. The following conditions apply:
[list]
[*] The character's name can be renamed once at the first login according to the usual rules.
[*] The rename is possible by using the old character data + old game world for a certain period of time to log in. If a character is connected to an S&F account, the login is done via this.
[/list]
[h3]Guilds[/h3]
Guilds will be transferred, provided there are still members after the character deletion (see above), but they must have a unique name.

If several guilds have the same name, these guilds will be renamed and can be renamed once by the guild leader.

The guild's honor corresponds to the old honor, but can be at most as high as the smallest honor value of a migrated top-1 guild.

If a guild leader is deleted, the officer with the highest level becomes the new guild leader; if there are no/further officers, the guild member with the highest level becomes the new guild leader.
[h3]Hall of Fame[/h3]
[list]
[*] The calculation for the Heroes' Hall of Fame is as follows: Honor/2, but at most as high as the honor value of the top-1 player of an old server with the lowest honor value.
[*] For all other Halls of Fame, the honor of the old server is adopted.
[*] The income that can be earned per day through Hall of Fame battles is limited to 100 million gold to prevent abusive behavior when multiple characters of a player have been moved.
[/list]
[h2]Communication[/h2]
On servers where a merge is imminent, a pop-up will be displayed daily for a certain period, pointing out the server merge. In addition, there will be an in-game message.

On the day of each server merge, a world will be frozen at midnight. As soon as the work in the background is completed, the characters on the new server will be released again.
[h2]Which servers will be merged?[/h2]
We will initially merge all US servers and the Canadian server. This is likely to happen at the end of July.

We will merge the aforementioned servers in a test merge, with the origin servers remaining parallel so that a data comparison is possible.

Creating a new character will not be possible on the new server during the test.

[b]Important![/b] We reserve the right to make changes to the concept if it should be necessary for compelling reasons!

notes.title: Voting for New Berserker Class Icon
notes.content:
We recently changed the class icon of the Berserker, which might have caught you a bit by surprise. In the following, we would like to explain our reasons for doing so and also present a few more concepts and suggestions, about which we would love to hear your opinions!
[h3]Why do we want to change class icons at all?[/h3]
The redesign of the class icon stems from the desire to better represent the unique ability that distinguishes each class.

The Berserker's axe, which can also attack with all other hand weapons, does not capture its class; its defining ability is to mercilessly strike at its opponent in a state of frenzy, and we want to try to visualize this.

In the Hall of Fame, it's desirable to make the icons in the smaller version more readable and intuitively recognizable, so that at first glance it's clear which opponent one chooses.
[h3]What was important to us about the Berserker class icon?[/h3]
The icon of the Berserker is a special challenge because it is about representing an emotion, namely frenzy, which we associate with heat and fire, without giving the impression that the Berserker has a fire attack.

In addition to the class icon, there is the option to also adjust the effect if this better represents the effect of the ability, we tried to avoid this in the first step, but we do not rule it out!
[h3]What would we like to receive in terms of feedback?[/h3]
We are aware that the community has gotten used to a certain icon and it's unfortunate to have to relearn this icon for each class with every update, so we are now taking this path to better consider your feedback in the redesign process and to arrive at the best possible solution.

We would be pleased if you could take a look at the new icon ideas and their associated effects, and let us know what you like best. For this, we would like to ask you to participate in the following survey:

notes.title: Producer’s Note #12
notes.content:
The next closed beta test is up and coming. This time you will have the chance to explore a new event we have created, an alternative way to spent thirst for adventure: the expedition event. In this producer’s note you will get some more background information about why we developed this event.

Read the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/438040/view/3693561465121204814]announcement[/url] to get some more information about the closed beta details.

[h3]What are the goals of the new expedition event?[/h3]
Shakes & Fidget celebrates its 14th anniversary this summer, and the quests have been with us for just as long. They are an important feature of the game to let your character make progress every day.

We have realized that this consistent routine of consuming thirst for adventure every day doesn’t provide the fun many players want.

Instead of developing a new feature that would increase the daily playtime and would require an additional investment, we have come up with an alternative for spending thirst for adventure. We followed the following guidelines:

[list]
[*] In late game, it must mean fewer clicks to spend thirst for adventure than the current mechanic. Spamming the enter key must still work.
[*] The mount should not only decrease the waiting time, but also increase loot.
[*] Players should still be able to decide whether they would like to focus on resources or XP (to the same extent as it is currently implemented in the game).
[*] The loot you gain per thirst for adventure spent must remain the same.
[*] It’s supposed to feel like you are actually on a quest where you make decisions yourself to have more control over the outcome of the quest.
[*] An alternative method to spend thirst for adventure will be planned as an event during which you won’t find pet eggs, but dungeon keys.
[/list]

[h3]That’s why we developed expeditions![/h3]
Expeditions take the conditions mentioned above into account and we would like to test with the beta how this alternative to classic quests in the form of an event is received.

For this, we have introduced a new NPC, an elderly explorer who will lead expeditions during the event from the counter of the tavern.

Each expedition has a special task that will reward the player with extra heroism upon completion.

The mount reduces both waiting times per expedition and increases the rewards of the final score, but it does not decrease the thirst for adventure cost as classic quests do.

On a total of ten clearings, the player must pick one encounter each to advance. Spending thirst for adventure on expeditions unlocks new encounters only after a certain number in order not to overwhelm the player.

For more information on expeditions, please read the article in our help center: [url=https://bit.ly/Beta08Info]https://bit.ly/Beta08Info[/url].

notes.title: Producer's Note #10
notes.content:
The topic we will be talking about today may be surprising. We are going to increase our pricing for the first time within the 13 years long Shakes & Fidget history, except of adjustments due to currency fluctuations.

Before you rage out about price increasements during inflation, please read the whole producer’s note to understand our motivation and why this does not mean that purchases will be more expensive per se.

[h3]Which Prices Will Be Increased and Why?[/h3]

We are going to increase prices in the mobile apps (Android & iOS) as well as in Steam. In the past, all three platforms had different price points, those will now be aligned.

Price increasements are necessary as the company structure has changed. From a small developer team of only seven people the team size increased to 35 employees within the last two years to ensure the operation of Shakes & Fidget as well as guaranteeing the future of the game. Additionally, this allows us to work on new products to diversify the company’s portfolio. Due to that the personnel cost increased significantly.

[h3]And What’s the Good News?[/h3]

Although prices will be increased this does not necessarily mean that you need to pay more than before. With the introduction of the WebShop (https://home.sfgame.net) we found a way to maintain our pricing but provide a possibility to you to purchase items outside of the game.

Together with the WebShop we are going to establish a Community Portal. This should be the place to go for the community in the future to find interesting information all around the game and a convenient option to purchase mushrooms and special packs, and last but not least special sales will be offered as well from time to time.

Find out more about the WebShop and the Community Portal here: [url=https://home.sfgame.net/]https://home.sfgame.net/[/url].

notes.title: Producer's Note #8
notes.content:
With this producer’s note we would like to provide some insights about the strategy for Shakes & Fidget.

Our goal for the years to come is to modernize Shakes & Fidget. We would like to create a better first time experience to increase accessibility for new players by providing a better guidance and feature explanation, incl. more transparency regarding the balancing. In addition, old features will be reworked to make them more fun and less repetitive for both, veterans and newbies.

As we see more and more players joining our game on mobile apps, we strive to optimize the gameplay experience for those. But this does not mean that we will not pay attention to the classic browser version or the Steam client anymore.

[h3]Dungeon Rework[/h3]
A good example to demonstrate our approach to modernize Shakes & Fidget would be the dungeons rework. The goal was make the feature to look more appealing, to be more transparent, to provide a better guidance, and to provide new content.

To achieve a more welcoming appearance we reworked the dungeon overview as well as the dungeon maps which have now themed buildings matching the dungeon’s monsters. All dungeons which are on the same map do now work the same way, containing ten floors each and do not have any special functionality. Special dungeons got their own space in the dungeon overview.

More transparency and better guidance was achieved by providing information about the dungeon unlock conditions directly on the map, displaying the opponent’s class and elemental damage as well as the last and the next opponent. Furthermore, when entering a dungeon map, the dungeon with the monster having the lowest level of all open dungeons will be preselected.

New content was implemented with the launch of 10 new dungeons (5 each for the light and shadow world).

Detaching the Continuous Loop of Idols for example provides us the possibility to extend this feature in the future. The same intention has the redesign of the dungeon maps. Separating the special dungeons also allowed us to display all needed information about their functionality on the first sight.

The navigation was changed to be more mobile friendly while still being comfortable to be used on PC, following common pattern for the latter while still improving the game’s handling on mobile apps.

[h3]Open Beta Tests[/h3]
You may have noticed that we did not run any open beta tests lately while still launching new or reworked features.

The new dungeons were not open beta tests as we did not see the necessity for a public beta test and we did not want to ruin the surprise of the dungeon’s release and their content.

Anyhow, we have learned our lesson from releasing the rebalanced druid without a previous open beta test. Not running a beta test was a mistake and, thus, we are working on a new and better system to run beta tests for future releases.

We have learned that the community’s feedback is important and very valuable when it comes to reworks and rebalancing. Keep your eyes open for the next open beta test and help us to make Shakes & Fidget becoming even more fun in the upcoming year(s).

[h3]International Servers[/h3]
The news of discontinuing the launch of international servers hit some of you unexpectedly and we would like to shed some light on that decision.

First of all, we will still launch new servers in the future but the naming will be different.

Currently, 95% of our players are from Central Europe but we would like to expand to other continents as well. To ensure that players on other continents will be able to play with a good performance, we will set up servers located on the respective continent and the naming will adapt to that location. Taking this into consideration, the naming of international servers would be misleading.

notes.title: Producer’s Note #6
notes.content:
You may wonder why we do rework/rebalance classes. With the following producer’s note we would like to provide some insights on why a class is being reworked, which problems have been identified, and how those are being solved.

[h3]Reworking the Druid[/h3]

When looking at the druid and how this class is currently performing in the game, we had the feeling that this class is a bit underpowered in comparison to the other classes.

In the following passages, we discuss which problems have been identified and present the solutions which will make a difference after the druid is being reworked.

[u]Problem:[/u]
The druid’s three forms are not unique and useful enough.

[u]Solution:[/u]
We took the decision to overhaul all three forms to make them more diverse in comparison to their partnering class.

Here are some details:

[i]The Bear Mask Will Become the Bear Form[/i]

The bear will still be able to block attacks but with a lesser chance than a warrior. To compensate this malus the bear will now be able to get angry and to deal more damage the more damage was dealt to itself.

The hit points scale and the max. damage avoidance will be comparable with a warrior.

These changes will reduce the bear’s survivability but strengthen its damage distribution so that the concept of the bear will better fit its theme.

[i]The Cat Mask Will Become the Tiger Form[/i]

The tiger will have two different states, being hidden in the shadow and being in rage.

At the start of each fight, the tiger will be hidden in the shadow which enables the tiger to dodge attacks but with a lesser chance than a scout. After dodging an attack, the tiger will get in rage, loosing the chance to dodge attacks but the chance to deal critical damage will increase.

The hit points scale and the max. damage avoidance will be comparable with a scout.

With these changes the tiger form will be more close to the other forms as the changes will reduce its survivability but being more reliable regarding dealing critical damage at the same time.

[i]Not Wearing a Mask Will Become the Eagle Form[/i]

This form haven’t had any benefits but was rather a penalization when being used. The druid will now take the eagle form and get a special attack.

Instead of a regular attack, the eagle will be able to perform a dive attack which will deal a significant amount of damage but the chance to perform a dive attack will decrease with each time a dive attack was performed.

Despite of that, the hit points scale and the max. damage avoidance will be comparable with a mage.
At the start of a fight, the chance to perform successful dive attacks will be quite high but the more often a dive attack was performed, the damage penalties will increase significantly as well with regular attacks.

This change is thought to be an additional and these changes should make the druid stronger and more interesting to be played.

[u]Problem:[/u]
The druid’s class identifying feature, the masks, are distracting and most druids do look the same even if the character avatar itself was lovingly designed.

[u]Solution:[/u]
The masks will no longer be a game feature but a claw fitting the chosen form will be displayed on the character screen.

[u]Problem:[/u]
Each form has its benefits effecting the skill points in one or another way. Currently, the according information is being hidden in several tooltips.

[u]Solution:[/u]
A screen will be introduced from which a form can be chosen. All necessary information will be displayed within this screen.

[u]Problem:[/u]
Access to the druid’s masks have a level restriction, meaning, the advantages of the class are not available right from scratch.

[u]Solution:[/u]
All forms will be available right from the start.

notes.title: Producer’s Note #3
notes.content:
At first, we would like to apologize for the recent performance issues and problems you may be experiencing on new backend servers. Please be assured that we are working on solutions to improve performance and gameplay experience with high priority.

With this producer’s note we would like to provide some more detailed information to let you know which challenges we are currently facing and which measures already have been carried out, are in our minds and are planned to be deployed as soon as possible.

At first, we need to clarify that we have to distinguish between three main issues we are facing right now.

[h3]New Backend Server Outage (15 June 2022)[/h3]

The recent server outage on Tuesday, 15 June 2022, was completely disconnected from the other issues related to the new backend.

Long story short, we got a false error notification from our monitoring which stated that we had a problem with our key value storage but it turned out that in reality some database proxies had some trouble.

When we found out that the error notification was false, we already deployed measures against the reported issues which, unfortunately, caused a high latency. Ironically, exactly the opposite of what we wanted to achieve. Anyhow, this was rolled back and the real problem with the database proxies could be solved and, eventually, the server performance went back to normal.

Nobody is perfect, mistakes can happen. We can only truly apologize for the unfortunate circumstances caused, thank you for your patience, and ask for your understanding.

[h3]Performance of New Backend Servers[/h3]

Starting to migrate servers went quite smooth in the beginning. The migration of small game worlds caused smaller issues which could be solved rather quickly. The more we advanced, the more confident we got and decided to start migrating bigger and more active servers.

Unfortunately, we underestimated the impact of the data amount which needs to be loaded simultaneously and its impact on the server load. As a result, the new backend servers’ performance started to decrease.

As a counter measure we upgraded the server power by adding additional game servers. Furthermore, the code base is being reviewed and refactored to identify and optimize parts of it that are expensive in terms of performance.

To see if our actions indeed have a positive impact on the server performance, we integrated specific methods to measure performance to be able to track if an optimization leads to an efficient improvement. The optimization is being done in iterative steps which enables us to monitor the possible improvements more closely.

What are the measures in detail? Redundant data is being reduced, old and no longer be needed data will be cleared on regular basis via scripts. The program code is being optimized to shorten response times and we are going to change the way how temporary session data is being saved. The same data is being required for many parts of the game. With an intelligent memory caching we expect to achieve an extremely better performance.

In some areas we are facing some limitations, though. Currently, we are dealing with two different code bases which need to be compatible. This hinders us to execute some improvements which can only be done once all servers have been migrated.

[h3]Bugs Occurring on New Backend Servers[/h3]

The last topic, we would like to discuss are the bugs which are currently occurring on new backend servers.

While we are focusing on improving the server performance first, the bugs you have reported are not being kept without any attention. We assume that the majority of the occurring issues will no longer occur once the server performance is on a stable level.

Nonetheless, some of our developers look intensively into identifying the sources of the reported bugs and are working on solutions where we could see that the problems are not only connected to performance issues. Again, the code base is being revised and refactored where we think it could help to fix a bug.

We would have wished that the server migration would have been done trouble-free. Sadly, the reality shows a different scenario. It is as annoying to us as to you but we have to face the current situation and deal with the challenges with high priority to make your and our lives less stressful.

Again, we appreciate your patience and thank you for your understanding and support but can also understand your disappointment that you are currently facing some uncomfortable situations while playing the game. We are on it!

notes.title: Upcoming Easter Update
notes.content:
Dear Shakes & Fidget Community, 

We would like to tell you more about the upcoming updates in Shakes & Fidget! Last year was great and we created many exciting new features, like the blacksmith, the new achievement system, and the Underworld. It won’t be an easy task, but the Shakes & Fidget team here at Playa Games is determined to do you one better this year – and it already starts with next week’s Easter update!
  
For the first time in the history of Shakes & Fidget, there will be a new class: the Assassin! The Assassin is a mix of Scout and Warrior, and the only class that can dual-wield weapons. 
We will also introduce a new dungeon with 20 levels: the Time-honored School of Magic. Any ideas what that might refer to and whom you’ll encounter there? 

There will also be a number of useful improvements. You can find out more about them soon in the official patch log! One feature that we initially planned to release is missing though: Last year in October, we announced that we are planning an update with a focus on guilds in the first quarter of 2018. So, instead of delaying the whole update, we will simply deliver the new guild feature once it’s ready in a few weeks. We also have big plans for after this update: You can expect the next surprise around Shakes & Fidget’s anniversary in June. We have been working on it for over a year now and it will be the biggest change the game has seen in three years! Are you curious, yet? 😊 

We wish you lots of fun, 
Your Shakes & Fidget team

notes.title: Pets update is coming soon!
notes.content:
There will be 100 pets that can be divided into 5 classes/colors: 
Fire, water, earth, light and shadow - with 20 pets each. Each class consists of 14 common, 4 rare and 2 epic ones. With a bit of luck common pets can be found on quests in certain regions at a certain time of the day, for example in the Busted Lands at night. Rare and epic pets are more difficult to find, for example only during a specific weekend event.

All pets can be found in eggs whose colors show a pet's class. You can raise and level up a pet until level 100 by feeding them with fruits. 

It's not only about the pleasure of collecting the pets as they can also fight! You are matched against a random opponent and color and have to choose one of your colors to start the fight. You can use every color only once a day, which limits battles to five a day. Defeat another player's pets to win food and make your way to the top in the new Hall of Fame for pets! 

In addition, there will be 5 new dungeons (called "Habitats"), one for each pet color, which can be only visited by a pet of the same color. Complete one of this habitats to receive an epic pet!

All this information is subject to change during development.

notes.title: Pets update and Easter event
notes.content:
We’re celebrating Easter with every special weekend event at once! This means that from March 25 to 28 you get more experience, more gold, more mushrooms, and more epic items (level 50 and up). And, above all, you get 20% more mushrooms with every purchase!

But that’s not everything, by a long shot! Shakes & Fidget unveiled the dark shadow world a few months ago. Now friendlier creatures will soon settle the land. This time you can collect, train and compete with them. The pets are coming!

The pets descend from the five elements of fire, water, earth, light, and shade. Tamed and trained by you, they can explore their own dungeons, pit their strength against others in battle, and improve your abilities. They’ll be here soon!

We wish you lots of fun,
Your Shakes & Fidget team
